string-array.name: capability_scopes
string-array.item: reads visible UI text, labels, roles, bounds, view IDs, and app/window metadata via Android Accessibility after consent
buddy flies to visible controls for guidance; no auto-tap
node-first taps and scrolls after Tap-for-me disclosure, per-action confirmation, and fresh screen verification; gesture fallback only on learned apps
ordinary non-sensitive editable fields only; password, OTP, card, CVV, recovery-code, private-key, and secure-window typing is blocked
registered, bounded, policy-checked recipes only; no LLM-authored free-form plans
Sarvam Bulbul v3 cloud TTS, opt-in, user-supplied API key required
Android SpeechRecognizer for push-to-talk voice input; on-device-first or on-device-only modes
Sarvam Saarika v2 cloud STT, opt-in consent, user-supplied API key required
Brave web_search, Jina fetch_page, and GitHub github_search for public information only; fetched content cannot trigger device actions
rate-limited advisory guidance after idle time; cannot click, type, scroll, or run recipes by itself
visible-only clipboard text help with size caps, dedupe, and secret-like content skips
notification listener plumbing exists, but user-facing notification processing and RemoteInput replies are not active
payments, purchases, checkout, money transfer, add-to-cart, applying coupons, and address or card edits stay blocked
banking, wallet, payment, authenticator, password-manager, and secure-window actions stay blocked
